scope: Windows 11 development host, separately identified desktop, disposable projects and loopback model.
before: With project A pinned, selecting a file while browsing a nested folder automatically put child/selected-child-note.md in selectedEntries at the model endpoint.

observations: Selected entry paths above use forward slashes for display. Each request had the same pinned authorized root.
Changing the selected file and switching tabs each invalidated a prior attachment. Refreshing unchanged selection preserved it. Sending consumed it.
An independent peer directory showed no attach control. Direct-root selection and Edit with Agent still supplied the intended file.
The same suite also passed pinned-auto, session cache, archive recovery, normal desktop exit, history scope, M1, M2, M3 and two-server M4.

verification.build: Verified each file of the extracted source against its inventory; built offline using locked Rust dependencies. Verified executable bytes, component manifest and all 748 ZIP manifest entries.

limits: Ordinary Agent Project tools can still inspect files under the authorized root; this change controls the automatically attached selection metadata.
This is a post-RC7 development preview. Clean Windows 10, clean Windows 11 and an authenticated model turn are outstanding for the frozen candidate.
